summary: President Trump criticized Pirro's decision to drop a vandalism case involving the Reflecting Pool renovation, blaming the pool's flawed design rather than the vandals responsible for the damage.
content: President Donald Trump had touted the Reflecting Pool update, one of many renovations in D.C. he ordered ahead of America's 250th birthday celebrations.

zh.title: 特朗普在皮罗决定撤销"倒影池"破坏案后大声抨击，称"安装有缺陷"是罪魁祸首
zh.summary: 特朗普总统批评皮罗撤销涉及倒影池翻新工程的破坏案的决定，将责任归咎于该池的设计缺陷，而非对损害负责的破坏者。
